chunks: Then on the Day of Resurrection you will dispute before your Lord.
ai.seo_question: What happens to people on the Day of Resurrection according to this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the inevitability of divine justice, where the disputes (khasamah) among individuals will culminate in their final reckoning before Allah. It serves as a reminder that earthly conflicts and claims will be fully resolved and judged by the Creator, emphasizing the transition from worldly contention to eternal accountability.
